text: Lean-checked sufficient contract: a weak query-domain output bound at k ≥ 0, exact final-output law under represent, and output-and-distance coverage of every Lean comparison kernel imply the pinned universal Oracle.lipschitz predicate. The representation, query distance, and coverage have not been constructed for a paper oracle machine; literal paper Definition 6.1 strictness and time/input quantifiers remain outside this theorem.
